assumptions.name: trips_per_day
assumptions.note: Outreach trips from the two stores, every day.

assumptions.name: boxes_per_trip
assumptions.note: Boxes of vaccine or rapid tests per carrier.

assumptions.name: good_cold_life_h
assumptions.note: Median cold life (rated hours at +43 C) of a well-packed carrier.

assumptions.name: worn_share
assumptions.note: Share of the fleet with worn seals or badly frozen packs.

assumptions.name: worn_cold_life_h
assumptions.note: Median cold life of those carriers.

assumptions.name: frozen_packs_p
assumptions.note: Trips packed with ice packs straight from the freezer (no conditioning).

assumptions.name: frozen_packs_h
assumptions.note: Hours the inside sits below 0 C when that happens.

assumptions.name: hot_vehicle_p
assumptions.note: Trips where the carrier waits in a closed vehicle in the sun.

assumptions.name: hot_vehicle_gain_c
assumptions.note: Extra heat on top of outside air while in the vehicle.

assumptions.name: depart_earliest_h
assumptions.note: Status quo departures: uniformly 07:00 to 12:00 local.

assumptions.name: planned_depart_h
assumptions.note: Planned departures: the forecast's cool morning slot.

assumptions.name: vvm_eye_sd
assumptions.note: Error when a person judges the VVM by eye (fraction of the way to the end point).

assumptions.name: vvm_camera_sd
assumptions.note: Error of the camera VVM measurement (from our synthetic-image tests).

assumptions.name: shake_test_sensitivity
assumptions.note: Shake test catches a truly frozen box.

assumptions.name: shake_test_specificity
assumptions.note: Shake test passes a box that didn't freeze.

assumptions.name: start_budget_max
assumptions.note: Budget already used before the trip: uniform 0 to this.

assumptions.name: pack_alert_acted_p
assumptions.note: Workers who re-condition packs when warned they're below 0 C at departure.
